question: The country names written across the land on the zoomed-out map: which font and texture, which countries, how each name is laid out, when it is built and drawn.

addresses.name: CountryMapNames_Draw
addresses.comment: **Draws every country's name on the map, rebuilding the dirty ones first.** All addresses rvas. One caller, MapGraphics_DrawScene at 0x45C39D, which passes the camera's +0x33C and +0x340 and calls it only where the zoom level (the count of CMap terrain_sheet_heights entries below the camera height, 0x45C07F..0x45C0D7) is not 0, the map style (GameSettings +0xF4) is not 0 - so not in the Terrain or Weather modes (FINDINGS-farmap.md A.3) - and CCurrentGameState +0xD0C scenario is null (MapGraphics_DrawScene_CountryNamesGate). Nothing in this function asks the camera. (1) Where g_CountryMapNames is empty, CountryMapNames_Resize to the game state's country count (+0xBC0 - +0xBBC). (2) Render states through the device at (global 0x16857CC)+0x64: ZENABLE 0, ZWRITEENABLE 0, ALPHABLENDENABLE 1, SRCBLEND SRCALPHA, DESTBLEND INVSRCALPHA, LIGHTING 0; stage 0 colour and alpha = TEXTURE x TFACTOR, stage 1 off; linear min and mag filter. **TEXTUREFACTOR itself is not set here.** (3) For each record i, in country-id order: where its dirty byte (+0x10) or g_CountryMapNamesRebuildAll is set, CountryMapName_Build(country i's tag at CCountry +0xCA4); then, where the record has a mesh (+0): SetTexture(0, the font's atlas - the graphics' texture table +0x15C, 0x2C a slot, indexed by the font's +0x49C, none where that is -1 or above 9999), world = D3DXMatrixTranslation(x - cameraX, 0.1, z - cameraZ) from the record's +8/+0xC, VertexBuffer_Draw. (4) Clears g_CountryMapNamesRebuildAll and puts the stage states back. No fade, no alpha of its own, no colour of its own. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-farmap.md, section B.
addresses.evidence: rvas. Read whole, 0x43ED10 to the bare ret at 0x43F129, 5 int3 before and 6 after. The caller pushes two floats with sub esp,8 and pops them with add esp,8 (0x45C387..0x45C3A2): cdecl, two stack floats. The render-state numbers are the D3D9 enums (7, 0xE, 0x1B, 0x13, 0x14, 0x89, and stage types 1..6), read off the pushes at 0x43EDCF..0x43EEF9. The 0.1 is the float at 0x11C05F8. Would be wrong if the device slots 0xE4/0x10C/0x114/0xB0/0x104 were not SetRenderState/SetTextureStageState/SetSamplerState/SetTransform/SetTexture - the same slots ProvinceTexts_Draw uses in the same order, where 0xE8 GetRenderState(0x3C) pairs with 0xE4 SetRenderState(0x3C) as a save and restore.

addresses.name: CountryMapName_Build
addresses.comment: **Lays out one country's name on the map.** All addresses rvas; 0x43D9E0 to the bare ret at 0x43ED0A. Clears the record's dirty byte; tag id 0, a country owning no province (CCountry +0xCF8 <= 0) or the tag REB: release the mesh and stop. **The land**: a flood fill from CCountry::GetCapitalLocation over neighbours (CProvinceTemplate +0x90 edges, +4 the id) that are land (+0x22) and controlled by the country (CMapProvince +0x338 controller_id) - the capital itself is taken unasked. For each province reached, every second pixel of its bounding box (+0x80..+0x8C) counts when the province raster (CMap +0x20E0) gives this province **or any sea**: sums of x, y, xy, x*x, y*y, the count N (64-bit), and the x and y extent. N = 0: stop, the old mesh kept. **The line**: least squares both ways - y on x from min x to max x, and x on y from min y to max y - each rasterised (MapLine_Rasterise, ends truncated to int) and trimmed (MapLine_TrimToCountry, sea allowed); ends ordered left to right; the longer kept. **The size**: the name (CountryNameOfTag), upper-cased by CharUpperBuffA where the font's slot 19 (its effect byte +8) is set; the font is the map object's +0x5F40 + 4 x the faction's icon (CFaction +0x3C), 0 for no faction - WaterObject +0x417C..+0x4188. With w, h from CEU3BitmapFont::GetTextSize and L the line's length: s = min(L / w x 10, (N / L x 40) / h, 25); no name where 6 x the name's length > L or s < 2.5. Then one more space between every pair of letters while w(spaced) x s / L < 11. **The anchor**: the line's midpoint less the left normal p = (-dz, 0, dx)/|d| times h x 0.5 x s x 0.04, into +8/+0xC. **The mesh**: a write-only buffer of 6 vertices for every non-space letter (XYZ|TEX1, 20 bytes), filled by BitmapFont_LayOutTextQuads(font, -, spaced name, origin 0, up p, along d, s, 100000), then CountryMapName_BendAlongLand, then unlocked. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-farmap.md, section B.
addresses.evidence: rvas. Read whole on the listing; one caller (0x43EFEA, push eax / add esp,4 - cdecl, one argument, country +0xCA4). The x87 divides checked by their bytes: d8 f1 at 0x43DF46 = Sx/N, de f1 at 0x43DF78 = Sy/N, d8 f9 at 0x43DFBE = cov/varX, de f9 at 0x43E07A = cov/varY, de f9 at 0x43E50E = (N/L x 40)/h. Constants read: 10.0 (0x120A340), 40.0 (0x120A2F8), 25.0 (0x120A640 double, 0x131DBA8 float), 6.0 (0x120A590), 2.5 (0x131DBBC), 11.0 (0x131DBB8), 0.5 (0x120A308), 0.04 (0x120A8C8). The import slot at 0x92B294 resolves to CharUpperBuffA. The font index: icon is 1 comintern, 2 axis, 3 allies in common/ideologies.txt, and +0x5F40 = 0x1DC4 (where the map object constructs its WaterObject, 0x2407BF) + 0x417C, so +0x5F44/+0x5F48/+0x5F4C are the comintern, axis and allies fonts the constructor loads in that order. Wrong if the sea test at 0x43DD87 (`cmp byte [edx+0x22],0; jne skip`) were the other way round - but CProvinceTemplate +0x22 is is_land, settled three ways in its own record.

addresses.name: MapLine_Rasterise
addresses.signature: void __cdecl MapLine_Rasterise(int x0@ECX, int y1@EAX, int y0@stack:4, int x1@stack:8, void* points@stack:0xC)
addresses.comment: **Bresenham's line from (x0, y0) to (x1, y1) into a vector of 8-byte (x, y) int points.** Steep (|dy| > |dx|) swaps the axes; the ends are put in increasing order of the major axis, so the points run that way whatever order they were given; the error grows by |minor delta| and steps when twice it reaches the major delta. At most 256,000 points (0x3E800). Pushes through rva 0x3C60F0. Callers: CountryMapName_Build twice, CountryMapName_BendAlongLand once a letter.
addresses.evidence: rvas. Read whole, 0x43C9F0 to the bare ret at 0x43CAD7. The callers load ECX and EAX, push three dwords and pop 0xC (0x43E131..0x43E14D). Wrong if EAX were y0 - but the function subtracts [ebp+8] from EDI (EAX) for the minor delta and ECX from [ebp+0xC] for the other, and the caller loads EAX from the second point's y (0x43E126, [ebp-0x48]).

addresses.name: MapLine_TrimToCountry
addresses.signature: void __cdecl MapLine_TrimToCountry(CMap* map, void* points, CCountryTag* tag, void* visited, bool allowSea)
addresses.comment: **Cuts a rasterised line down to the stretch that lies on a country's land.** A point is the country's where it is inside the map (CMap +0x2A74 x +0x2A78), its pixel's province is land, controlled by the tag (template +0x10 -> +0x338) and marked in `visited`. (1) Drop everything after the last such point and before the first. (2) If any point is then outside the map, empty the vector. (3) Walk it once: a point continues the current run where it is the country's, or is land with controller 0, or is sea and `allowSea`; anything else ends the run; the longest run (the first of equals) is kept and the rest erased. Nothing kept means nothing changes. CountryMapName_Build passes allowSea 1, CountryMapName_BendAlongLand 0.
addresses.evidence: rvas. Read whole, 0x43CAE0 to the bare ret at 0x43CE75; five stack arguments, add esp,0x14 at both callers. The best run is replaced only on a strictly longer one (`cmp ecx,[ebp-8]; jle` at 0x43CDC2), which is what makes the first of equals win. Template +0x10 is taken to be the province because it is read at +0x338 exactly as CMap +0x2200[id] is read in the flood fill - inferred, the template's +0x10 has no record.

addresses.name: CountryMapName_BendAlongLand
addresses.no_signature: cdecl with twelve stack dwords (map, tag, visited, vertices, vertex count, start x, end x, end y, anchor x, anchor z, min x, max x; add esp,0x30 at the caller) and the start y in XMM1 (rva 0x43EB0B), a float register no signature here can place.
addresses.comment: **Bends a laid-out name along the country's land with a Catmull-Rom spline.** Nothing where |end y - start y| <= 0.1 (the double at rva 0x120A3C0): a level line stays straight. Otherwise, for each letter (6 vertices): its centre (vertices 0 and 3, plus the anchor); the line through it at slope -(dx/dy), from min x to max x, rasterised and trimmed with allowSea 0; the midpoint of the run left. The first letter's is F, the last's L, their mean A. Two phantom points: P0 = F + |F-A| x dir(2 angle(F-A) - angle(A-L)) and P3, its mirror at L; where P0's x exceeds P3's, the two ends are swapped. Then for the i-th character of the unspaced name (spaces skipped, t = i / (length - 1)): t <= 0.5 runs D3DXVec2CatmullRom(P0, F, A, L, 2t), t > 0.5 runs (F, A, L, P3, 2(t - 0.5)); the tangent from a second point 0.01 away (behind where that parameter > 0.5, ahead otherwise), D3DXVec2Normalize'd; the letter's quad is rebuilt centred there with its own half-width (|v1 - v0| / 2) along the tangent and half-height (|v3 - v1| / 2) across it. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-farmap.md, section B.
addresses.evidence: rvas. Read whole, 0x43CE80 to the bare ret at 0x43D9DB. The import slots at 0x92B428 and 0x92B424 resolve to D3DXVec2CatmullRom and D3DXVec2Normalize; the 0.5 and 2.0 are 0x11AB304 and 0x120A360, the 0.01 0x120A288. The phantom-point arithmetic (0x43D1A7..0x43D39B) is read as a rotation of (d.u, u x d) by d's own direction; the closed form above is that reading restated, and is the part to recheck first - inferred as geometry, the instructions themselves are not.

addresses.name: CountryMapNames_Resize
addresses.comment: Resizes g_CountryMapNames to `count` records: erases the tail (CountryMapNames_Erase) or reserves and appends new ones (CountryMapNames_ConstructNew), **each new record with mesh 0 and its dirty byte 1**, so every name is built on the first frame that draws them. Callers: CountryMapNames_Draw and CountryMapName_Build, each only where the vector is empty.
addresses.evidence: rvas. Read whole, 0x43F130 to the bare ret at 0x43F1E3; the count arrives in EAX at both callers (0x43EDC7, 0x43DAA3). The size is (end - begin) / 0x14 by the 0x66666667 / sar 3 idiom.

addresses.name: CountryMapNames_Erase
addresses.signature: CountryMapName** __stdcall CountryMapNames_Erase(CountryMapName* first@stack:4, CountryMapName* last@stack:8, CountryMapName** out@EDI) @EAX
addresses.comment: std::vector::erase(first, last) on g_CountryMapNames: copies the 0x14-byte records down, destroys the tail through rva 0x43F6E0, sets the end; answers `out` holding `first`.
addresses.evidence: rvas. Read whole, 0x43F300 to `ret 8` at 0x43F364; EDI is the out slot (`mov [edi],ebx; mov eax,edi`).

addresses.name: CountryMapNames_Reserve
addresses.comment: Room for `extra` more records in g_CountryMapNames: 'vector<T> too long' past 0xCCCCCCC, and where size + extra exceeds the capacity (the vector's third word, global rva 0x168C390) a new capacity (rva 0x43F650) and a reallocation (rva 0x43F530), neither read.
addresses.evidence: rvas. Read whole, 0x43F370 to the bare ret at 0x43F3D2; likely - the two callees are named from their place in the std::vector pattern, not read.

addresses.name: CountryMapNames_ConstructNew
addresses.signature: void __cdecl CountryMapNames_ConstructNew(CountryMapName* first@EAX, int count@ECX, int unused@stack:4)
addresses.comment: Constructs `count` records from `first`, each {mesh 0, three dwords left as the stack had them, dirty byte 1}. The caller pushes a dword it never reads.
addresses.evidence: rvas. Read whole, 0x43F690 to the bare ret at 0x43F6DB: [ebp-0x14] = 0 and the byte [ebp-4] = 1 (EDX) are copied into each 0x14-byte slot; [ebp-0x10]..[ebp-8] are never written.

addresses.name: UShortDeque_Construct
addresses.comment: An empty std::deque<unsigned short> (0x14 bytes: proxy, map, map size, offset, size) at ESI - the flood fill's queue of province ids in CountryMapName_Build.
addresses.evidence: rvas. Read to its bare ret at 0x43F22A; likely - the element size 2 is from UShortDeque_PushBack's `mov word [ebx],cx` and 8 to a block; named from that shape.

addresses.name: UShortDeque_PushBack
addresses.signature: void __stdcall UShortDeque_PushBack(unsigned short* value@stack:4, void* deque@ESI)
addresses.comment: deque<unsigned short>::push_back: grows the map through rva 0x43F3E0 when the block is full, allocates a 0x10-byte block (8 ids) where needed, stores the word, ++size.
addresses.evidence: rvas. Read whole, 0x43F250 to `ret 4` at 0x43F2C8.

addresses.name: ByteVector_ConstructFilled
addresses.signature: void __stdcall ByteVector_ConstructFilled(char* value@stack:4, void* vector@ESI, unsigned int count@EDI)
addresses.comment: A std::vector<char> of `count` copies of *value - CountryMapName_Build's `visited`, one byte for every province id (CMap +0x21FC), all 0.
addresses.evidence: rvas. Read to `ret 4` at 0x43F7A2: 'vector<T> too long' guard, allocation through 0x1F60, a byte loop.

addresses.name: BitmapFont_LayOutTextQuads
addresses.signature: int __stdcall BitmapFont_LayOutTextQuads(CEU3BitmapFont* font, void* vertices, Hoi3CString* text, float* origin, float* up, float* along, float scale, int maxWidth)
addresses.comment: **Writes a text's glyphs as flat quads in 3D**, six 20-byte vertices (x y z u v) to a glyph: nothing for an empty text. Lines break at a newline, a carriage return or past maxWidth (at most 55 lines); each line is centred - its pen starts at minus half its width - and the first line's top is (lines) x the font's lineHeight (+0x494). A glyph (the font's +0x94 table, by the raw byte) of height under 1 only advances the pen (xadvance +0x18, plus the kerning pair), so **a space makes no quad**. Its quad spans x = pen + xoffset (+0x10) to that + width (+8) and y = top - yoffset (+0x14) - height (+0xC) to top - yoffset; texture u, v = its pixel rectangle over the atlas size (+0x4A0, +0x4A4). World position = origin + along x (x x 0.05 x scale) + up x (y x 0.05 x scale). Never reads the font's colour (+0x38). Callers (rvas): CountryMapName_Build, ProvinceTexts_Update (0x4563FC) and the battle-plan arrow texts (0x663D13).
addresses.evidence: rvas. Likely: read 0x6FF5E0 to the `ret 0x20` at 0x700156 for the layout and the first quad's arithmetic (0x6FF8B0..0x6FFDD7); the remaining vertex stores were not checked one by one, and the return (a counter at [ebp-0x18]) was not traced. The 0.05 is the double at 0x120A510. No virtual table holds it (vtable.py --holding).

addresses.name: CEU3BitmapFont::GetTextSize
addresses.signature: void __thiscall CEU3BitmapFont::GetTextSize(CEU3BitmapFont* this, Hoi3CString* text, int maxWidth, int maxHeight, void* border, short* size)
addresses.comment: Slot 13. **A text's size in the font's pixels**: width = the widest line of xadvance plus kerning, wrapping past maxWidth (0 means 0x140), with the escapes skipped as GetStringWidth skips them (0xA7 and its letter, `{`, the `@` flags and the 0xA3 counter names at their icon widths); height = lines x lineHeight (+0x494); each plus twice the border (a word at border+0, a dword at border+4). size[0] = width, size[1] = height. maxHeight is not read.
addresses.evidence: rvas. Read whole, 0x700160 to `ret 0x14` at 0x70036E. vtable.py --holding 0xB00160: CEU3BitmapFont slot 13 alone.

addresses.name: VertexBuffer_Create
addresses.signature: int __stdcall VertexBuffer_Create(void* mesh, void* device, int count, int stride, int fvf, bool dynamic)
addresses.comment: CreateVertexBuffer(count x stride, usage WRITEONLY (8) or WRITEONLY|DYNAMIC (0x208), fvf, pool by the mesh's byte +0x14) into a 0x24-byte mesh holder, which the callers then lock and fill. The country names make 6 x letters vertices, the province texts 300 apiece, both with stride 0x14 and fvf 0x102 (XYZ|TEX1).
addresses.evidence: rvas. Likely: read the head to the CreateVertexBuffer call (device slot 0x68) and the `ret 0x18` at 0x6D45AD; the lock was taken from the callers, which unlock through slot 0x30 of the holder's +0 afterwards.

addresses.name: VertexBuffer_Draw
addresses.comment: Draws a 0x24-byte mesh holder: nothing where +0xC is 0; its vertex declaration (+0x1C) or FVF (+8), SetStreamSource(0, +0, 0, stride +0x18), then the draw. Used by the country names and the province texts.
addresses.evidence: rvas. Likely: read to the first exits (bare ret at 0x6D4CAF); the draw call itself was not followed.

addresses.name: ProvinceTexts_Create
addresses.comment: **The near map's province names**, built once as the map is made (the 'CreateProvinceTexts()' step, called at rva 0x454084): for every map tile (WaterObject +0x19C, 0x3C0 a tile, +0x18C x +0x190 of them) and every province object in it, a 0x60-byte entry on the tile's deque (+0x120): the template's name (CProvinceTemplate_GetName), the province id, a byte set where the province is sea, text_position (+0x3C/+0x40) less the tile's centre, text_rotation (+0x54) and text_scale (+0x58), slot -1.
addresses.evidence: rvas. Read whole, 0x456710 to `ret 4` at 0x456A0B; one caller. The tile centre is (column x +0x194 + +0x194/2, row x +0x198 + +0x198/2), column and row the tile index's remainder and quotient by +0x18C.

addresses.name: ProvinceTexts_CreateBuffers
addresses.comment: Clears the 1000 slots at WaterObject +0x2D8 (0x10 a slot: used byte, alpha, start time, entry) and gives every province text a dynamic 300-vertex buffer (VertexBuffer_Create(.., 300, 0x14, 0x102, 1)) - 50 letters, which is why the update cuts a name longer than 50 to 49. Callers (rvas): the map build (0x45408A) and 0x46829D.
addresses.evidence: rvas. Read whole, 0x456610 to `ret 4` at 0x45670A.

addresses.name: ProvinceTexts_Update
addresses.comment: Each frame the camera is below 100 (the double at rva 0x120A358, tested by the caller at rva 0x45D6D9): every used slot's alpha = (now - its start) x 170, capped at 255; then for every visible tile (+0x78, count +0x88) each entry that is shown (+0x44) and has no slot takes the first free one of the 1000 - alpha 0, or 255 where the byte WaterObject +0x4288 is set (cleared after) - and is drawn into its buffer with the tahoma_60 font (+0x4178) through BitmapFont_LayOutTextQuads (maxWidth 320), rotated by text_rotation and scaled by text_scale x 0.5, a name longer than 50 cut to 49.
addresses.evidence: rvas. Likely: read the fade loop and the slot taking (0x455EA0..0x456130) and the call at 0x4563FC; the vectors handed to the layout between 0x456160 and 0x4562C2 were not worked through. The 170 is the double at 0x120A790.

addresses.name: ProvinceTexts_Draw
addresses.comment: Draws the province names: the same render states as CountryMapNames_Draw, the tahoma_60 font's atlas, and for each shown entry with a slot of non-zero alpha in each visible tile the tile's matrix (+0x17C) and TEXTUREFACTOR = alpha << 24 | 0xFFFFFF, saved before and put back after. MapGraphics_DrawScene calls it (rva 0x45C411) only below camera height 100 and where layer-mask bit 8 ((GameSettings +0xF0) & (+0xEC)) is set.
addresses.evidence: rvas. Read whole, 0x4608D0 to the bare ret at 0x460D20; `mov edi, ebx` before the call. The gate: `cmp byte [ebp+0xb],0` (camera < 100, set at 0x45BF13) and `test byte [ebp-0x14],8` at 0x45C403..0x45C40D.

addresses.name: CProvinceManager::CProvinceManager
addresses.no_signature: The object is the first stack argument (`mov ebx,[ebp+8]`), not ECX; EDX is stored at +0x44 as a further argument; `ret 0x3C` - fifteen stack dwords. No ordinary __thiscall describes it.
addresses.comment: **The constructor of the map renderer the record calls WaterObject**, whose RTTI name is CProvinceManager (vftable rva 0x11E3384, base CLostDeviceInterface). One caller, the map object's constructor at rva 0x2407D8, which builds it at its own +0x1DC4. Among much else it stores the graphics at +0x3C and the CMap at +0x40; makes a 0x9C8-byte MT19937 at +0x4170 seeded with 42; looks up the light type MapSetLight into +0x416C; and loads five fonts by name - each tried in the graphics' `fonts` table (+0x88) and then `bitmapfonts` (+0x94): tahoma_60 into +0x4178, neutral_country +0x417C, comintern_country +0x4180, axis_country +0x4184, allies_country +0x4188. The last four are read only through the map object's +0x5F40, in CountryMapName_Build.
addresses.evidence: rvas. Read 0x44F570 to `ret 0x3C` at 0x44FBE0. The vftable write at 0x44F593 is VA 0x15E3384, which hoi3_tfh-classes.json gives to CProvinceManager. The font strings are pushed at 0x44F99B..0x44FB28 with the stores at 0x44F9ED..0x44FB74. A negative control on the four country fonts: a resumed sweep of all .text (3,084,578 instructions) finds no read of +0x417C..+0x4188 at all while it does find both reads of +0x4178 and every store - the reads are through +0x5F40 (0x43E420), found by the same sweep.

addresses.name: MapGraphics_DrawScene_CountryNamesGate
addresses.comment: `cmp dword ptr [ebp+0x10], 0` - the gate on CountryMapNames_Draw, in MapGraphics_DrawScene: [ebp+0x10] is the zoom level, the count of CMap +0x40 terrain_sheet_heights entries the camera height (camera +0x348) is above, set at rva 0x45C09A..0x45C0CE (one entry, 500, in Their Finest Hour's and BlackICE's map/default.map). Then GameSettings +0xF4 map_style must be non-zero (rva 0x45C2E9) and CCurrentGameState +0xD0C scenario null (rva 0x45C373); with a scenario, MapGraphics_DrawTerraIncognita (rva 0x4602E0) is called instead, at rva 0x45C2CF, and no names are drawn.
addresses.evidence: rvas. Read 0x45C07F..0x45C3A2. The level loop takes i+1 for every entry below the height, compared as floats (cvtdq2ps of the int entry). CMap +0x40 is terrain_sheet_heights by CMap::LoadKey's case for token 0x6B5 (0x898D6: `add ebx,0x40` with ebx = this).

addresses.name: MapTextType_vftable
addresses.comment: **The table of what a `mapTextType` block in a .gfx file makes** - 31 slots, no RTTI, so the name is ours. Slot 0 the destructor (0x7170B0), slot 6 (0x717120) sets the instance's +0x44 to its argument + 0x158, slot 18 is C3dObjectType::CreateInstance (0x43AD10, a plain C3dVisibleObject); the rest are the object-type family's shared bodies. core.gfx declares one, `MapText`, and **nothing looks that name up**: the string "MapText" exists only as the tail of "MessageMapText" (VA 0x15CFFEB), which nothing references. The country names do not use it. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-farmap.md, section B.1.
addresses.evidence: rvas. Written by MapTextType_Construct at 0x717095; slots read off VA 0x1605D78. Positive control on the lookup negative: "MessageMapText" at VA 0x15CFFE4 has its push at VA 0x699906 (ShowMessageMapText), found by the same findValue scan that finds nothing for VA 0x15CFFEB.

addresses.name: MapTextType_Construct
addresses.comment: Constructs a 0x90-byte `mapTextType` object type in EAX: CPersistent's token 0x18D at +4, two empty strings at +8 (the name) and +0x24, zeroes, MapTextType_vftable, the graphics at +0x8C. Its one caller is ObjectType_CreateByToken's case for token 0x5D.
addresses.evidence: rvas. Read whole, 0x717060 to `ret 4` at 0x7170A2.

addresses.name: ObjectType_CreateByToken
addresses.signature: void* __stdcall ObjectType_CreateByToken(void* reader@stack:4, int token@stack:8, void* graphics@ECX) @EAX
addresses.comment: **Makes the object type a keyword in an `objectTypes` block names**, by its token: 0x135 animatedmaptext (0x114 bytes, 0x7166D0), and through a byte table at VA 0xA70A9C and a jump table at VA 0xA70A5C fourteen more - among them 0x5D mapTextType (MapTextType_Construct, 0x90 bytes) - and for any other token the unknown-key report (0x67A7B0) and null. Stores the token at the result's +4. One caller, rva 0x440B2B.
addresses.evidence: rvas. Likely: the switch head (0x670550..0x670597), the jump tables decoded byte by byte, and the cases for 0x135 and 0x5D read; the other thirteen cases' classes were not identified. Tokens from the registration: mapTextType 0x5D at 0x8F5F13, animatedmaptext 0x135 at 0x8F8433.

addresses.name: g_CountryMapNames
addresses.comment: **std::vector<CountryMapName>**, begin here, end at rva 0x168C38C, capacity at rva 0x168C390: one 0x14-byte record per country, by country id. Its byte +0x10 is the per-country dirty flag that Province_SetController (old and new controller), CFaction::AddCountry, CCountry::LeaveFaction, CustomGame_LeaveFaction, MakeVassal, AnnexCountry, CProvince_ResetState and RemoveLandlessCountriesFromWars set, each only where the vector is not empty. Freed at exit by rva 0x925D80, which does not release the meshes.
addresses.evidence: rvas. A resumed sweep of .text for VA 0x1A8C388..0x1A8C390 finds 68 operands in those eight setters, the module 0x43D9E0..0x43F6DB and the teardown 0x925D80 - and nothing else. The record's own prose already called +0x10 'a per-country display dirty byte' in several entries; this names what it is dirty for.

addresses.name: g_CountryMapNamesRebuildAll
addresses.comment: A byte: where set, CountryMapNames_Draw rebuilds every country's name, and clears it. **Nothing in the image sets it** - it sits in .data's uninitialised tail, so it is 0.
addresses.evidence: rvas. Likely dead: the resumed sweep finds two operands on VA 0x1BEA4C1 (the read at 0x43EF3C and the clear at 0x43F0EA) and no pointer to it in .text, .rdata or .data. Positive control: the same sweep finds both, and the neighbours VA 0x1BEA4C0 and 0x1BEA4C2 with their own readers. A write through a computed address would not be seen.

structs.name: CountryMapName
structs.comment: One country's name on the map, an element of g_CountryMapNames. Our name; no RTTI.
structs.evidence: The stride is 0x14 at every index (`lea eax,[eax+eax*4]` then `*4`) and the vector's size is (end - begin) / 0x14 by 0x66666667 / sar 3; CountryMapNames_ConstructNew writes exactly five dwords a record.

struct_fields.name: mesh
struct_fields.comment: The 0x24-byte vertex-buffer holder of the laid-out letters; 0 where the country has no name on the map.
struct_fields.evidence: rvas. Created at 0x43E9F0 (new 0x24), handed to VertexBuffer_Create and VertexBuffer_Draw, released through 0x298D10 at 0x43E9EB and 0x43EC4C.

struct_fields.name: font
struct_fields.comment: The faction's map-name font, from the map object's +0x5F40 + 4 x the faction's icon.
struct_fields.evidence: rvas. Stored at 0x43E430; its +0x49C picks the atlas at 0x43F006.

struct_fields.name: x
struct_fields.comment: The anchor's map x: the chosen line's midpoint less the normal's x times h x 0.5 x scale x 0.04.
struct_fields.evidence: rvas. Written at 0x43E97D, read at 0x43F072 into D3DXMatrixTranslation's x less the camera's.

struct_fields.name: z
struct_fields.comment: The anchor's map y (world z), the same way.
struct_fields.evidence: rvas. Written at 0x43E9C3, read at 0x43F042 into the translation's z.

struct_fields.name: dirty
struct_fields.comment: Rebuild before the next draw. Set to 1 by new records and the eight setters on g_CountryMapNames, cleared by CountryMapName_Build.
struct_fields.evidence: rvas. Cleared at 0x43DAB7, tested at 0x43EF35, constructed 1 at 0x43F6AB.

struct_fields.name: map_light
struct_fields.comment: The light type MapSetLight, looked up in the graphics' lightTypes table by the constructor.
struct_fields.evidence: rvas. 0x44F984..0x44F9A3: the name pushed, 0x6704A0 called with the graphics in ESI, which searches +0xAC (lightTypes, FINDINGS-gui.md); inferred from that table.

struct_fields.name: rng
struct_fields.comment: A 0x9C8-byte MT19937 of the renderer's own, seeded with 42 (MT19937Seed) by the constructor. Readers not looked for.
struct_fields.evidence: rvas. 0x44F930..0x44F96E: new 0x9C8, +0x9C0 = 0, +0x9C4 = 1, `mov eax,0x2a; call` MT19937Seed (0x6A2BF0), stored at 0x44F95E.

struct_fields.name: font_province_names
struct_fields.comment: The font called tahoma_60 (in Their Finest Hour a bitmapfont over kart_font, color 0xff333333): the near map's province names.
struct_fields.evidence: rvas. Stored at 0x44F9ED; read at 0x4563F0 (ProvinceTexts_Update) and 0x460A40 (ProvinceTexts_Draw).

struct_fields.name: font_neutral_country
struct_fields.comment: neutral_country: a country in no faction's map name. Read as the map object's +0x5F40.
struct_fields.evidence: rvas. Stored at 0x44FA4E; read at 0x43E420 with index 0.

struct_fields.name: font_comintern_country
struct_fields.evidence: rvas. Stored at 0x44FAB0; read at 0x43E420 with the faction's icon.

struct_fields.name: font_axis_country
struct_fields.evidence: rvas. Stored at 0x44FB12; read at 0x43E420 with the faction's icon.

struct_fields.name: font_allies_country
struct_fields.comment: allies_country: faction icon 3. An icon above 3 would read past it, into +0x418C.
struct_fields.evidence: rvas. Stored at 0x44FB74; read at 0x43E420 with the faction's icon.

struct_fields.name: text_rotation
struct_fields.comment: positions.txt's `text_rotation`, radians: the province name's angle on the near map.
struct_fields.evidence: rvas. The positions loader's case for token 0x3D3 (text_rotation, registered at 0x8FF75B) stores the parsed float at 0x90288; ProvinceTexts_Create copies it into each entry.

struct_fields.name: text_scale
struct_fields.comment: positions.txt's `text_scale`: the province name's size on the near map.
struct_fields.evidence: rvas. The case for token 0x3D6 (text_scale, 0x8FF7CD) stores at 0x902EF; ProvinceTexts_Create copies it.
